content: niriWayle follow-up: KDE global shortcuts wired — kglobalaccel-user-dinit (org.kde.kglobalaccel.user unit + shim override) + Alpine kglobalacceld (daemon /usr/lib/libexec/kglobalacceld; no upstream activation file) added to BOTH niri and niriWayle package lists, activation-only per ADR-010; Alpine XDG autostart .desktop inert (niri/Wayle ignore /etc/xdg/autostart); harness NEW kglobalaccel_daemon. User decisions: dms-shell split DROPPED (not planned); Booster initramfs module policy RESOLVED (parked behavior final). Validated 107/107 dinit (2026-10-19T17-52-35Z) + 91/91 OpenRC (2026-10-19T17-59-49Z).

CORRECTION: kglobalaccel/kglobalacceld is a KDE global-shortcuts service (Plasma-session component) — NOT a niri/Wayle dependency (no KWin/GlobalShortcuts integration for Wayland key grabbing; the KDE apps shipped on niri do not use it). Wiring commit 92116e4 REVERTED (packages removed from both DE lists + kglobalaccel_daemon check + service-list entry). The aports kglobalaccel-user-dinit unit/shim override stay optional (installing the daemon alone gives no activation route — add the unit package too; the KF6 kglobalaccel LIBRARY is a transitive dep of kio/kded/kwallet and gets installed regardless — only the daemon matters). Other decisions: dms-shell split DROPPED; Booster module policy RESOLVED (final). Validated after revert: 106/106 dinit (2026-10-19T22-01-31Z) + 90/90 OpenRC (2026-10-19T22-13-26Z).
